scope: Each sequence retains actual original/native RAM, ordinary CPU and FPU producer results across ten public ABI calls. Named special-register inputs stay fixed; MACL remains its unchanged declared input. Device/firmware services are unused by these bodies. Inputs change only explicit call arguments/entry/return link and the caller-supplied fifth stack argument. Busy rejection, then successful bind and field updates are observed without injecting callee results. This is a component API lifecycle, not uninterrupted natural startup.
